notes: BMW-only Australian Tier 1 passenger BEV reconciliation. Fifteen named configurations across ten exact model/body cohorts are reviewed, including seven new catalogue rows. Brand directories are not complete independently published whole-market BEV lists, so publishedLists remains empty and overall C1 closure is not claimed.

Every currentVersionReview is restricted to its stated maker generation, production revision, code or arriving launch cohort. It is not a whole-family certificate that outgoing/residual-new variants have been exhausted.

The inherited broad iX, iX1, iX2, iX3, i4, i5 and i7 records/leads remain unresolved where earlier codes, outgoing grades, additional performance scopes or residual new stock are not settled. A retained selector, price guide, approval listing or failed dealer page is not a current New advertisement.
Current iX1 Sport Collection is a separately named marketing configuration with unknown exact code; it does not inherit 22HM identity or count as a fifth compact-SUV drivetrain grade.
i5 Sedan and i5 Touring are separate bodies. NA0 i3 Sedan is separate from the historical I01 hatch. No generic family name joins these identities.

NA5 iX3 40 and i7 LCI have arriving Q4 2026 scopes; NA0 i3 Sedan and NA7 iX4 have reported Q1 2027 Australian arrival windows. Current maker listing or Build & Price does not establish an accepted order, actual delivery or physical unsold stock.
iX5 60 xDrive and i3/iX3/iX4 M60 orders-in-2027 material remains future-only. These future configurations are outside the fifteen admitted rows and are not silently added to current reviews.
Formal manufacturer model year is unverified for these exact Australian current cohorts and remains null. Calendar year, guide publication month and advertisement year do not populate it.

This dated reconciliation accompanies the staged, unregistered BMW packet. Original source data and registered packets are preserved; no physical stock, accepted factory order or whole-market C1 closure is asserted.

The currentVersionReviews reporting schema evaluates only on-sale cars. Six wholly on-sale source-bound cohorts are supplied here. Four arriving or mixed-arrival cohorts, including NA5 40/50, retain all source-bound identities in the companion census but their current-on-sale review is withheld. This avoids false identity mismatches or a sampled list that conceals announced versions. No arriving vehicle is promoted to on-sale for reporting.
